findings.claim: Scene validation permits 0 through 12 lights; inactive lights are skipped.
Point/directional emits 1 sample; each interactive rectangle emits 64 samples and one area. Therefore sample count is 0...768 and area count is 0...12, both exact Float32 integers.
Point/directional color.w is zero; every rectangle sample uses the exact one-based area index. Nonzero tags are integral 1...areaCount.
The sole public packed constructor uses interactive quality and always emits raw grid 8, even with empty sample and area arrays.
Constructor resolution is 24...192, divisible by 3, height=width*2/3. Native wrapper skips out-of-grid threads.
Empty arrays receive a one-row SIMD4<Float>.zero backing allocation, not a zero-byte Metal buffer; count remains zero and loops do not dereference those arrays.

Candidate finite/range/integrality guards precede uint casts; width bound precedes width multiplication; raw grid equality precedes grid cast; nonzero tag guard precedes index subtraction. No packed ABI change.

Host parser requires six parameter rows, <=2304 sample rows, <=36 area rows, both lengths divisible by 3, finite row values, and exact metadata-count/row-count equality. No lane02/03/19 parser request is needed.

limits: Header raw pointers carry no lengths; arbitrary caller must supply valid backing rows.
